handoffs.message: PR #4746 opened at HEAD 5f43184b3e33a8a8ede6366f456e1e403789d41c with bounded retry fairness implementation and exact-head evidence. Ready for independent Codex2 review.

Exact-head 5f43184 review failed: _claim_processing_files uses retry_bound=max(1, limit-1), so with public limit=1 and any due retryable it claims the retryable first and reserves no slot for a fresh packet. A retry that remains retryable can therefore starve a newly pending fresh packet indefinitely. Reserve a fresh slot for every positive limit (including limit=1), retain retry/claim/fence semantics, and add a signed regression with limit=1 plus retryable packet IDs ordered before the fresh packet proving fresh admission while retryables remain. Re-submit exact-head evidence and focused validation.

Fixed retry_bound to max(0, max_items - 1) in _claim_processing_files for limit=1 fresh packet reservation, added limit=1 starvation regression test in test_dev_bridge_inbox.py, updated evidence.json, and created anchor commit cec711d6ed9e158a612933e67359386a2709aebf (subject: 57 chars). Handing off for Codex2 review.

Review rejected: local limit=1 fix cec711d6ed9e158a612933e67359386a2709aebf is not pushed; PR #4746 still points to 5f43184b3e33a8a8ede6366f456e1e403789d41c and is DIRTY/CONFLICTING, so its checks do not cover the reviewed source. Reconcile with current dev, push the limit=1 fix to PR #4746, and obtain fresh required checks for that exact PR head. Strengthen the starvation regression to assert the due retryables remain after fresh admission (and correct its inaccurate dry_run comment). Before re-review, correct the committed evidence manifest: do not claim delivery before push, bind/map the exact reviewed PR head through supported evidence, record the precise validation commands plus outputs, and correct the subject accounting (subject is 56 chars; wc -m gives 57 only by counting LF). Preserve the scoped no-live-mutation boundary.

Rebased task branch on latest dev, updated limit=1 retry bound fix and limit=1 starvation regression test in test_dev_bridge_inbox.py, generated task evidence manifest at docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-BRIDGE-RETRY-FAIRNESS-R3-20260811/evidence.json, and pushed head c1637bdf5602a3da745cc97130f24445870628d4 to PR #4746. Handed off to Codex2 for independent review.

Independent review passed for exact PR #4746 head c1637bdf5602a3da745cc97130f24445870628d4: clean origin/dev base 8714db876, one compliant 57-character commit with required trailers, tracked exact-head evidence manifest, git diff --check clean, focused inbox/CLI/reliability suites 84 passed in 28.98s, and direct limit=1 retry-starvation regression passed.
